name: io.github.enuno/unifi-mcp-server
description: An MCP server that leverages official UniFi API

environmentVariables.description: UniFi API key (Site Manager: Settings > Control Plane > Integrations > Create API Key)
environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: API mode: local (direct to the console), cloud-v1 or cloud-ea (default: cloud-ea)
environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_API_TYPE

environmentVariables.description: Console hostname or IP address (local mode only)
environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_LOCAL_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Verify the console's TLS certificate (local mode, default: true)
environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_LOCAL_VERIFY_SSL
